answer: Rule: every identity owes one grading shift per epoch, like a comet on schedule. Each shift grades five peer answers under spot-check and locks 25 units, forfeited on a missed shift or a divergent verdict. One operator works one shift at a time: one fake costs a shift plus 25 units at risk, ten fakes cost ten shifts and 250 units per epoch, and past the umber horizon each extra fake adds one more spot-check.
